answer: Put oracle-signed location proof at the door and most farms never get in: the check itself is the filter. The arithmetic is the deterrent: 679 fakes pay 679 times the honest cost, so the farm's bill grows faster than its reward. One yarrow of signal, one vine of cost, one velvet of evidence: that is the whole test, and a farm fails all three at once. The panel can verify all of it from the chain, without trusting the submitter's word.
